title: Renewal Studio: Building a System for Software and API Contract Renewals
description: A workflow-by-workflow engineering series: from a standard renewal to exceptions, consumption risk, retention, finance, agents and operations.

parts.title: The Standard Renewal, End to End
parts.description: Follow a contract through eligibility, a versioned offer, buyer acceptance, activation and recovery. Explore four interactive workflows.

parts.title: When the Standard Path Ends
parts.description: Commercial exceptions, custom contracts, legal review and strategic negotiations: who owns the next decision, and what evidence travels with it?

parts.title: Renewing a Commitment When Usage Changes
parts.description: Consumption signals, commitment burndown, shortfall risk and rightsizing an offer around a credible usage picture.

parts.title: Retention Beyond the Renewal Date
parts.description: Pay-as-you-go retention, cancellation, save offers and winback: connect interventions to the customer's actual situation.

parts.title: The Work After the Sale
parts.description: Post-sale tasks, customer communications, specialist queues and partner handoffs, with an owner for every unresolved outcome.

parts.title: Follow the Money
parts.description: Invoices, collections, credits, refunds and revenue schedules: reconcile financial outcomes with the accepted agreement.

parts.title: Let Agents Work Within a Boundary
parts.description: Schedules, durable delivery, policy, provider adapters and evaluations: decide which actions can run and how to verify them.

parts.title: Forecast the Business from the Work
parts.description: Weekly renewal forecasts, risk models, performance measures and portfolio simulations grounded in usage and contract state.

parts.title: From Demonstration to an Operational System
parts.description: Architecture, identity, source connectors, audit, recovery and the evidence a production pilot would need.
